name: SessionStart - Inject Safety Context
description: Injects important safety context and checks at the beginning of each session

actions.content:
🛡️ SAFETY GUARDRAILS ACTIVE

This session has comprehensive guardrails enabled:
• File deletion operations are gated
• Database modifications require confirmation
• API calls are rate-limited and validated
• Credential files are protected
• Dangerous terminal commands are blocked

If you need to bypass a guardrail, explicitly request an exception.

actions.content:
📋 OPERATIONAL POLICY REMINDERS

1. Always backup before modifying pipeline.json
2. Test email templates in draft before sending bulk emails
3. Review recipient lists before sending campaigns
4. Never commit credentials to version control
5. Run tests after dependency updates
